name: Teen Camp
description_short: A weekly summer program for teens ages 13 to 15, based at the Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich clubhouse on Horseneck Lane. Teens go on field trips and local travel, do service learning and leadership training, and take part in cooking classes, yoga, sports and beach days. Club membership is required.

sources.note: 2026 Teen Camp handbook: home base 4 Horseneck Lane; 9:00 to 4:00, drop-off from 8, pick-up by 5; bring lunch or lunch money, bathing suit daily
2026 Teen Camp schedule: eight weeks, Week 2 is June 29 to July 2
2026 brochure: Teen Camp $275 weekly plus annual membership; discounted fees and Care 4 Kids accepted

source.title: Teen Camp : Summer Camps : What We Do : Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 22 – August 14, 2026), which is already over as of 2026-10-13. Dates for 2027 have not been posted.
The camp is offered week by week, but the page does not list the individual weeks. It is recorded as one season-long block.
The address and phone number are the Club's main contact details from the page footer. The page does not say exactly where Teen Camp meets.
The page says the program is 'designed for high school students' but lists ages 13–15, which includes some middle-school ages.
The page does not directly say campers go home each night. 'Day' is inferred from the field-trip and downtown-walk format.

refund_policy_summary: Refund requests before May 8 at 5pm carry a $70 non-refundable fee; no refunds after that. Membership is not refundable, and membership and registration can't be transferred.
swim_waterfront_notes: Teens bring a bathing suit and towel every day; the schedule includes beach days at Tod's Point and swimming.
